frames.headline: Room left on four AI plans
frames.composition: Dark app capture. Four provider cards; 72% Claude session, 38% weekly, 61% Fable.
captureNotes: U7 fixtures unify Fable at 54% left (CompanionDemoData.fableUtilization = 46 used); the storyboard composition says 61%. The capture will show 54% unless the fixture or the composition changes.

frames.headline: The same numbers, as widgets
frames.composition: Home Screen composition: Nested Meter large (Claude/Codex), Vessel Hero smalls (Grok/Cursor). Primary accounts only.
captureNotes: Widgets have no per-widget provider choice: every placed widget reads the same main-account projection and shows the Mac's widget selection (at most two providers). Vessel Hero smalls for Grok and Cursor beside a Claude/Codex Nested Meter is not a state a real Home Screen can reach. The wall renders what real widgets would show from the fourProviders variant (Nested Meter large plus Vessel Hero and Tightest First smalls) until Kyle picks an honest composition.

frames.headline: Your Mac does the reading
frames.dependencies: U8, U18, U21; Mac capture gate
frames.composition: Mac menu-bar strip and popover behind phone capture. Match readings: Claude weekly 38%, Codex weekly 64%.
captureNotes: TODO: Mac imagery needs `swift run Headroom --render-popover <dir>` for the multi-4 scenario, which today renders a plain two-provider popover (BUGS.md: 'The harness's multi-account path renders neither Grok/Cursor nor the spend card'), or one live --demo multi-4 capture Kyle explicitly approves. The capture script skips this frame until macCapture points at an approved PNG.

frames.headline: Each account gets its own rows
frames.composition: Claude Personal/Work/Studio and Codex Personal/Work stacked by provider. Main accounts first.

frames.headline: API spend next to plan usage
frames.composition: Show Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI spend below plans, with period chips. No dollar amounts in captions.
captureNotes: No U7 variant is spend-first, and none carries xAI spend (multiAccount and fourProviders publish Anthropic and OpenAI only). The spend rows sit below five accounts, so the usage screen's opening position may not show them. Needs a spend-first variant or a scroll anchor from U8/U21, and an xAI spend fixture if the composition keeps xAI.

frames.headline: A different style per widget
frames.composition: Four widget styles: Nested Meter, Vessel Hero, Tightest First, Liquid Level. Use actual iOS widgets.
captureNotes: The wall draws the shared widget views at iOS widget point sizes inside the app; it is not SpringBoard. Draft layout: Nested Meter medium, Vessel Hero and Tightest First smalls, Liquid Level medium.

frames.headline: Turns red at 15% left
frames.composition: Red 12% weekly numeral in Claude Work. Pair with Tightest First widget using the same main-account reading.
captureNotes: multiAccount already poses Claude Work weekly at 12% left (88 used). Claude Personal is main in every variant, so a Tightest First widget would show Personal, not Work: the widget pairing needs a fixture with Work as main (copy doc: do not pretend widgets aggregate accounts).

frames.headline: Your meter style carries over
frames.composition: Four actual card captures: micro.chip.event, full.segmented.ghost, micro.tube.hue, full.machined.event.
captureNotes: displayChoices poses one style (full.segmented.ghost). Four styles in one frame needs four captures composed side by side, or a phone --meter-style launch argument; neither exists yet.
